dict.string: Fathom is a file manager: it shows and manages the files on your Desktop when you open it.
Fathom is a file manager: it shows and manages the files in Documents when you open it.
Fathom is a file manager: it shows and manages the files in Downloads when you open it.
Fathom shows and manages files on external drives when you open them.
Fathom shows and manages files on network drives when you open them.
Fathom asks Finder to move items to the Bin, so Put Back still works.
